preconditions.description: The number of water tanks n is between 2 and 50, inclusive.
The maximum increase in pipe width k is between 0 and 1000, inclusive.
The width of each pipe cij is between 0 and 10^6, inclusive, and cii is 0.

preconditions.expression: cij = 0 if there is no pipe from tank i to tank j
preconditions.description: If cij is 0, then there is no pipe from tank i to tank j.

postconditions.description: The output is a single integer representing the maximum amount of water that can be transmitted from the main tank to the sewer tank per unit of time.
